name: merge-conflict-resolver
description: Tonic merge markers: highlights, CodeLens, conflict explorer, merge editor hooks

commands.title: Tonic: Import merge report JSON (CI artifact)
Tonic: Apply merge report markers to workspace file
Tonic: Preview Git conflicts as Tonic markers (new buffer)

tonic.defaultReportGlob.description: Glob hint for merge report artifacts (shown in docs; Import command uses native file picker).

tonic.agent.provider.description: Provider used by 'Tonic: Resolve with Agent Provider'. clipboard/cursor/copilot copy prompt; customCli executes local command.

tonic.agent.customCli.command.description: Shell command for custom CLI provider. The hydrated prompt is sent on stdin; stdout must be JSON: {"resolved_lines": [...], "rationale": "..."}.

tonic.agent.customCli.timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for custom CLI provider.

tonic.highlight.enableSemantic.description: Enable semantic highlight colors based on conflict labels and optional tags.

tonic.highlight.defaultPalette.description: Built-in palette used when semantic highlights are enabled.

tonic.conflictLabelConfig.description: Optional JSON rules for semantic label/tag-based highlighting. Example: {"rules":[{"kind":"added right","tags":{"intent":"security"},"backgroundColor":"#ffd1d1"}]}

tonic.gitMergeIntent.leftDefault.description: Default left (base) intent tag when reconstructing legacy git-merge regions without tags.

tonic.gitMergeIntent.rightDefault.description: Default right (head) intent tag when reconstructing legacy git-merge regions without tags.

tonic.gitMergeAuthor.leftDefault.description: Optional default left author tag for reconstructed git-merge markers (empty uses "base").

tonic.gitMergeAuthor.rightDefault.description: Optional default right author tag for reconstructed git-merge markers (empty uses "head").

tonic.gitMergeAuthor.preferHumanAlias.description: Reserved for future use: prefer human-readable aliases when reconstructing from minimal report rows.

scripts.test: npm run compile && node --test out/test/parser.test.js out/test/agentIntegration.test.js out/test/promptTemplates.test.js
